intro.title: You already know · what you do with them
intro.title_cz: Už znáš · co s nimi děláš

intro.title: Accounts, and when it goes wrong
intro.title_cz: Účty a když se to pokazí

intro.title: Four words you already know in a new sense
You will use these words in
frames: The … is slow because … · *… je pomalý, protože …*
The … does not work when … · *… nefunguje, když …*
intro.note: **hack** is what a person does to a system; a **bug** is a mistake in the program itself. Neither is a **virus** — that is a program somebody wrote to do damage.
intro.note_cz: hack = útok člověka · bug = chyba v programu · virus = škodlivý program.

blocks.title: Technology · accounts and when it goes wrong

sentences.en: My laptop battery lasts four hours, but it was ten hours last year.
sentences.cz: Baterie v mém notebooku vydrží čtyři hodiny, ale loni to bylo deset.
accepts: My laptop battery lasts four hours, but it was ten hours last year

sentences.en: I wear headphones on the train so that I can work.
sentences.cz: Ve vlaku nosím sluchátka, abych mohl pracovat.
accepts: I wear headphones on the train so that I can work

sentences.en: His smart watch tells him when he should stand up.
sentences.cz: Jeho chytré hodinky mu řeknou, kdy by se měl postavit.
accepts: His smart watch tells him when he should stand up

sentences.en: The mouse stopped working after I dropped it.
sentences.cz: Myš přestala fungovat, když mi spadla.
accepts: The mouse stopped working after I dropped it

sentences.en: The speaker in the kitchen plays music all morning although nobody listens.
sentences.cz: Reproduktor v kuchyni hraje hudbu celé dopoledne, i když nikdo neposlouchá.
accepts: The speaker in the kitchen plays music all morning although nobody listens

sentences.en: The cable is too short to use behind the desk.
sentences.cz: Ten kabel je příliš krátký, aby se dal použít za stolem.
accepts: The cable is too short to use behind the desk

sentences.en: The plug does not fit the socket because this hotel is old.
sentences.cz: Ta zástrčka nepasuje do zásuvky, protože je tenhle hotel starý.
accepts: The plug does not fit the socket because this hotel is old

sentences.en: There is only one socket in this room, but the office next door has four.
sentences.cz: V téhle místnosti je jen jedna zásuvka, ale ve vedlejší kanceláři jsou čtyři.
accepts: There is only one socket in this room, but the office next door has four

sentences.en: The touchscreen does not work when my hands are wet.
sentences.cz: Dotyková obrazovka nefunguje, když mám mokré ruce.
accepts: The touchscreen does not work when my hands are wet
The touchscreen doesn't work when my hands are wet

sentences.en: A wireless keyboard is better than a cable on a small desk.
sentences.cz: Bezdrátová klávesnice je na malém stole lepší než kabel.
accepts: A wireless keyboard is better than a cable on a small desk

sentences.en: The hardware is fine, but the problem is the program.
sentences.cz: Hardware je v pořádku, ale problém je ten program.
accepts: The hardware is fine, but the problem is the program

sentences.en: The signal is bad in the office behind the station, although the wifi works.
sentences.cz: V kanceláři za nádražím je špatný signál, i když wifi funguje.
accepts: The signal is bad in the office behind the station, although the wifi works

sentences.en: I cannot connect to the wifi in this room although my phone shows it.
sentences.cz: V téhle místnosti se nemůžu připojit k wifi, i když ji telefon ukazuje.
accepts: I cannot connect to the wifi in this room although my phone shows it

sentences.en: You have to install the app before the meeting.
sentences.cz: Tu aplikaci si musíš nainstalovat před schůzkou.
accepts: You have to install the app before the meeting

sentences.en: The update took an hour, but it changed nothing.
sentences.cz: Ta aktualizace trvala hodinu, ale nic nezměnila.
accepts: The update took an hour, but it changed nothing

sentences.en: Please save the file before you close the computer.
sentences.cz: Ulož prosím ten soubor, než počítač vypneš.
accepts: Please save the file before you close the computer

sentences.en: Please back up your files before you leave the office.
sentences.cz: Zazálohuj si prosím soubory, než odejdeš z kanceláře.
accepts: Please back up your files before you leave the office

sentences.en: The photos are in a folder which nobody has opened for years.
sentences.cz: Ty fotky jsou ve složce, kterou už roky nikdo neotevřel.
accepts: The photos are in a folder which nobody has opened for years

sentences.en: The browser is slow because I have thirty pages open.
sentences.cz: Prohlížeč je pomalý, protože mám otevřených třicet stránek.
accepts: The browser is slow because I have thirty pages open

sentences.en: You can change that in the settings if you know where to look.
sentences.cz: Můžeš to změnit v nastavení, pokud víš, kde hledat.
accepts: You can change that in the settings if you know where to look

sentences.en: Send me a screenshot when the message comes again.
sentences.cz: Až se ta zpráva objeví znovu, pošli mi snímek obrazovky.
accepts: Send me a screenshot when the message comes again

sentences.en: I need to scan the paper before I send it to the office.
sentences.cz: Musím ten papír naskenovat, než ho pošlu do kanceláře.
accepts: I need to scan the paper before I send it to the office

sentences.en: We stream the football because the television is broken.
sentences.cz: Fotbal streamujeme, protože televize je rozbitá.
accepts: We stream the football because the television is broken

sentences.en: Every notification comes to my watch, but I never look at them.
sentences.cz: Každé upozornění mi chodí na hodinky, ale nikdy se na ně nedívám.
accepts: Every notification comes to my watch, but I never look at them

sentences.en: I stopped the subscription because the price went up twice.
sentences.cz: Zrušil jsem to předplatné, protože cena dvakrát stoupla.
accepts: I stopped the subscription because the price went up twice

sentences.en: She sent the report as an attachment, but I could not open it.
sentences.cz: Poslala tu zprávu jako přílohu, ale nešlo mi ji otevřít.
accepts: She sent the report as an attachment, but I could not open it
She sent the report as an attachment, but I couldn't open it

sentences.en: I saved the photos to the cloud after my old phone broke.
sentences.cz: Fotky jsem uložil do cloudu, když se mi rozbil starý telefon.
accepts: I saved the photos to the cloud after my old phone broke

sentences.en: The new app has a bug which deletes the last line.
sentences.cz: Ta nová aplikace má chybu, která maže poslední řádek.
accepts: The new app has a bug which deletes the last line

sentences.en: The computer will crash if you open too many files.
sentences.cz: Počítač spadne, jestli otevřeš moc souborů.
accepts: The computer will crash if you open too many files
The computer'll crash if you open too many files

sentences.en: The internet is very slow tonight because everybody is watching films.
sentences.cz: Internet je dneska večer hodně pomalý, protože všichni koukají na filmy.
accepts: The internet is very slow tonight because everybody is watching films

sentences.en: If you restart the phone, the problem usually goes.
sentences.cz: Když telefon restartuješ, problém většinou zmizí.
accepts: If you restart the phone, the problem usually goes

sentences.en: The bank was offline all morning, but the shops still took cards.
sentences.cz: Banka byla celé dopoledne mimo provoz, ale obchody pořád braly karty.
accepts: The bank was offline all morning, but the shops still took cards

sentences.en: They tried to hack the school website, but nobody lost any work.
sentences.cz: Pokusili se nabourat do školního webu, ale nikdo nepřišel o práci.
accepts: They tried to hack the school website, but nobody lost any work

sentences.en: Half of my spam is about cheap flights, although I never fly.
sentences.cz: Půlka mého spamu je o levných letenkách, i když nikdy nelétám.
accepts: Half of my spam is about cheap flights, although I never fly

sentences.en: The message about the free phone was a scam, but my father believed it.
sentences.cz: Ta zpráva o telefonu zdarma byl podvod, ale můj táta jí uvěřil.
accepts: The message about the free phone was a scam, but my father believed it

sentences.en: You can block a person who writes to you every day.
sentences.cz: Můžeš zablokovat člověka, který ti píše každý den.
accepts: You can block a person who writes to you every day
